name: warm-watch
description: Keeps your chats warm and tells you before one goes cold: sets cache-tax to show a cold send's price without asking, keeps chats warm for a day after their last message, and notifies you if one is about to cool anyway.

warnMinutes.title: Warn this many minutes before cold
warnMinutes.description: How long before the cache is expected to go cold the notification fires.

ttlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: 60 on a Claude subscription; 5 on API keys unless promptCacheTtl is 1h.

minContextTokens.title: Only warn above this context size
minContextTokens.description: Small conversations are cheap to re-cache, so they get no warning.

coldSend.title: Cold sends
coldSend.description: warn (default): a send into a cold cache goes through with its price shown. ask: cache-tax asks Send or Don't send first.

keepWarmFor.title: Keep chats warm for
keepWarmFor.description: How long cache-tax keeps each chat warm after its last message (its /keepwarm always window). Pings cost a cache read each, about every 50 minutes. off leaves cache-tax as you set it.
